purpose: Defines the review priority system (P1/P2/P3), the priority-severity relationship, severity catalogs, exclusions, create_issue conditions, and the fixed three-section structure of review criteria files.
summary: P1 rule conformance, P2 contradiction, P3 unnecessary complexity definitions
Priority and severity are independent axes; severity source of truth is delegated principles
Severity catalogs for document references and terminology violations
Exclusions: no omission detection in P2, no subjective P3, no extra perspectives
Proportionality check for fix decisions and handling of expired ADR rejection reasons
Fixed three-section structure and template for review_criteria files
Criteria hold no severity or gray-zone judgments; priority among multiple SoTs
tasks: Deciding fix, create_issue, skip, or needs_review
title: レビュー優先度仕様
